docs.purpose: The "choose your lot" page (MF-53): where the search lands when an address does not resolve to exactly one lot, and its honest message states. One address over several lots: the lots are outlined on a map with a letter each, listed as cards (area, frontage, zoning) under the map, and the chosen lot opens its report. An address found with no linked lot: the plain message "No lot linked yet", the pin and the faint neighbouring lots, never a silent nearest-lot pick. Several such addresses: the message only. More than 10 lots on one address: "This address has many lots. Add a unit number or pick a nearby address." An intersection: "That looks like an intersection. Type a house number to see the lots." (the map version is MF-60). Nothing is selected when the page opens.
docs.data_story: It reads one contract, GET /api/parcels/lookup?q= (C-001), through the same query the search page already filled (['parcel-search', q]), so the normal flow makes no extra request. The server names the outcome (`resolution`) and, only for multi_parcel and unlinked, sends the `map` block: lot outlines (parcels.geom), area (parcels.lot_size_sqm, the report's area rule), frontage (parcels.frontage_m), zoning (parcels.zoning_zn_string), marker points (parcels.centroid_lat/lng), the address pin (address_points.latitude/longitude), a start view and the faint neighbour outlines. It emits **no analytics event**.
docs.under_126: **CONVERTED (MF-53)** — LIST with `render.projection: map`, rendered by the shared mobile binding (LotMapBinding.tsx props, SurfaceRenderer.tsx parts) from this descriptor and its content file. The map is react-native-maps' own MapView, Polygon and Marker configured by props; it owns no component (`owns.components[]` is empty).

identity.owner: unassigned (no CODEOWNERS file and no owner registry exists in the repo — measured 2026-09-16)

versioning.why: It reads the lookup response as sent; `resolution` and `map` are optional in the mobile mirror, so a payload from an older server still parses and falls back to the client derivation.

inputs.why: One GET /api/parcels/lookup?q= through useParcelSearch, the same TanStack entry the search page filled. The route param `q` is the query; the outcome comes from the response, never from the `kind` param.

outputs.why: It writes nothing: the only action is opening the chosen lot through the report route helper.

state.why: No store: the tapped lot is component useState in the mount (nothing selected at open), cleared when the page leaves.

staleness.why: useParcelSearch declares a 60-second staleTime; the page reuses the search page entry.

session.why: It inherits the tab gate and the parcel-tool Stack: shell_app_tabs will not mount the tab tree at all unless subscription_status is trial/active/past_due/admin_managed.

rls_class.why: parcels, address_points and parcel_address_points are RLS-enabled with zero policies (default deny), read as the table owner through C-001.

guards.rate_bucket: parcels-search:{uid} — 60/min, 60s window (the search bucket; the page shares the search request)

list.item_archetype: lot card (Lot letter, area, frontage • zoning) under the map; on the map a polygon and a letter marker per lot
list.recycling: none — at most 10 lots by the contract

checks.why: operator ruling 2026-09-16 (match TYPE, never count): the unlinked case must render a VISIBLE "no lot is linked to this address" state. Picking the nearest polygon and presenting it as the answer is explicitly forbidden, and it is the kind of thing that is invisible once shipped — hence blocking, not advisory. The paired lock upstream is mobile/__tests__/parcelSearchMatch.test.ts, which asserts a zero-candidate response derives `no_match` and never `unlinked`. Dated note 2026-11-11 (MF-53): now enforced on the built page: the unlinked and unlinked_no_pin goldens (miss, empty) render the visible message with nothing selected; the server names unlinked only when live address points with the number exist and have no lot link (src/tests/parcel-lookup-resolution.logic.test.ts, the anti-guess case); a zero-point miss stays no_match.

DECISIONS-v3 Q4 (and P35-D17 a on the sibling list): nothing is selected when the page opens and Continue is disabled until a tap; a neighbour pick is the user's choice, never a default. Locked by mobile/__tests__/lotMapScreens.golden.test.ts on every golden and named case.

MF-53 D-5 b: an intersection shows the honest no-map message now; the corner-lot map is MF-60 (queue row). Replaces parceldisambig_stub_is_visible, retired 2026-11-11 (MF-53): its own text said it flips the day the route renders a MapView, and it now does.

errors.why: Every failure class has its own notice (the search page's classes and copy); the schema drift text has no Retry.

classes.ui: A distinct locked-out line: the parcel tool is not in the current subscription. Explicitly says this is not a missing address.
Inline red "Too many searches. Try again in Ns." from RateLimitError.retryAfterSeconds.
Inline red "Couldn’t reach the lot service." with a Try-again button wired to refetch().
Inline red "We couldn’t read the response for that address" and NO retry button — a deterministic failure is not worth a second round trip. Sentry already has it.

emits.why: No client analytics in MF-53; the only record of a search is the server log line, which omits the query, the map address, the pin and the start view.

metering.why: A map response shows no report and counts nothing (MF-45 fold 12 carry); the chosen lot opens through the metered parcelId path.

config.why: The neighbour radius and limit of the unlinked map are admin-editable logic variables read by the contract (DECISIONS-v3 item 2 b, migration 307); the page itself has no tunable.

sharing.why: It shares C-001 and its search query with the search page (S-002).

deviations.from: Spec 126 §11a.1 closed binding set (content, contract, ...): no source for client-reshaped map values
deviations.why: P35-D14 a form: the query text, the lot count, the lot letters, the start view as a map region, the pin, the dark map style (the app's existing DARK_MAP_STYLE, mobile/src/constants/tokens.ts) and the polygons (GeoJSON reshaped to react-native-maps coordinates and holes) are derived on the client by mobile/src/lib/lotMap.ts and bind as {"derived": name}. Closed list: query, lot_count, region, pin, map_style, letter.<i>, lots.<i>.marker, lots|neighbours.<i>.polygons.<j>.coordinates|holes (LOT_MAP_DERIVED_NAMES in LotMapBinding.tsx; the mobile golden test refuses any other).
deviations.adjudicated_by: operator 2026-11-09, Wave 1 decision batch item 13 ("P35-D14 (a) deviation"), applied to this page by MF-53 plan v4 (operator 2026-11-11: "\"choose your lot\" and \"address issues\" screens should be built now")

deviations.from: Spec 126 §11a.1 / Spec 135 FE-21: map tiles are an external_embed, declared in the embed file (binding-sources.json external_embed, "file": null until MF-39)
deviations.why: The base map tiles under the lot outlines are the platform map (Apple Maps on iOS, Google on Android) through react-native-maps; MF-39 has not landed the external_embed file, so the tiles are declared here instead. Moves to one map_tiles line in that file when MF-39 lands it.
deviations.adjudicated_by: operator 2026-11-11, MF-53 item 3: "c as long as this is the simple and best in class solution here" (fallback b: this deviation, MF-39 not landed)

limitations.what: The chosen lot opens the report route the search page's `unique` opens (the REPORT surface mobile_parcel_detail, [parcelId].tsx). The new report (MF-48) is mounted nowhere yet, so today that route still draws the hand-built screen; MF-48 Stage B converts it in place (waits MB-44).
limitations.measured: mobile/src/lib/lotMap.ts route = parcelSearchRoute('unique'); MF-48 Stage A "mounted nowhere" (wf1/mf48-1111 47a5aa407).

limitations.what: "Report incorrect lot match" and the "report it" link of the no-lot-linked message are not on the page: MF-46 adds them with Help & Support (DECISIONS-v3 item 4 b).
An intersection shows the message only; the corner lots on the map are MF-60.
limitations.measured: mobile/src/lib/lotMap.ts — state intersection draws no map

limitations.what: The map is hidden from screen readers; the lot cards are the accessible list of the same lots. Faint neighbours (no linked lot) are map-only: a screen-reader user gets the message and its "Try a nearby address." line.

notes: Created by operator ruling 2026-09-16 (match TYPE, never count), which separated the map disambiguation from the SEARCH surface on the grounds that it reads parcel geometry and S-002 does not. Archetype is LIST, not a new "MAP" archetype, because Spec 126 §3.1 defines a map as a `render.projection` — the same call already made for `mobile_map`. This is the next surface to build; it is blocked on the API change recorded in S-002’s limitations. Dated note 2026-11-11 (MF-53, prior text kept): built and converted; the API change it was blocked on landed in the same row (resolution and map on C-001).

programme.why: The map half of the parcel tool’s entry flow — same Spec 100 feature, same address lookup, reached when the address does not resolve to exactly one lot.
